name: Flick
source:
A visual novel about a deaf child named Syn, who isn't quite sure what exactly they've gotten themselves into by stepping on a broken lightbulb in a mysterious forest.

[from [url=https://scoliwings.itch.io/flick]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一部关于失聪孩子辛的视觉小说。在神秘森林里踩到一只碎灯泡后，辛还不太明白，自己究竟卷入了怎样的事情。

[摘自[url=https://scoliwings.itch.io/flick]itch.io[/url]]
